title: Los Angeles County Winter Storm Press Conference
description: Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors Chair and First District Supervisor Hilda L. Solis will host a press conference to provide the latest updates on the storm system impacting Los Angeles County. The briefing will include information on the flood watch, sandbag distribution sites, mud and debris flow forecasts, rain preparedness tips, road conditions, and other related updates. A Q&A with media will follow the press conference.
